source.ui: User-provided Rewards screenshots, rounded to cents

provenance: Captured in the prior audit; Epoch 4 orders/collateral through 2026-11-03 archive, Epoch 5 final account and candle refresh on 2026-11-09.
limitations: This is the sampled parent's two accounts, not a protocol-wide raw export.
Epoch 4 hourly market candles and historical order book/quotes were not retained.
Wallet-paid gas, builder charges, and any unrelated account activity are not included.
Epoch CSV is not payment proof, and claimable balances may cover multiple epochs.
Market and transaction IDs are stable pseudonyms only within this package.
